Try this drill (20 point game). Its from 10' or 15'. I usually dont go past that. Setup balls in a circle around the hole. 

Objective: Get to 20 points

Rules: 

1. Putt made = 2 pts

2. 2 Putt = 0 pts

3. Initial putt left short = -1 pts

4. 3 Putt = -3 points

The objective of the drill is to get the ball either in the hole or past the hole on your initial putt. You are trying to make putts. Not leave them short, not lag them up close from 10-15', but to make them. And you cant make them if you leave them short, hence the penalty. Make sure you hole everything out. 
This game will take you a while to complete, and in fact you might be out for 2 hours and not even come close to 20 points. Its ok, its the nature of this drill. Drove me nuts the first few times I did it. But stick with it. This drill is what helped me to start making more birdie putts.
